topIssues.title: Flashblocks support within Geth
topIssues.author: maoueh
topIssues.body:
# Rationale

We have internally added support in `op-geth` for processing flashblocks events from Websockets, reconstructing a payload then block and tracing it through Geth Live Tracing feature (incremental tracing).

Wanted to open this issue to check if there would be openness to merge our implementation directly in `op-geth` (fully or partially).

# Implementation

- Websocket clients + connection handling (reconnection) for consuming Flashblock events
- Flashblock payload state tracking + payload reconstruction
- StateDB management
- Flashblock execution + Live Tracing

## Not Present

- RPCs handling of `"pending"` state to query available Flashblock(s) execution.

topPRs.title: txpool: drop interop transactions on reorg
topPRs.author: karlfloersch
topPRs.body:
## Summary
- Interop executing messages (targeting CrossL2InboxAddress) depend on cross-chain state that may be invalidated by reorgs.
- When discarded blocks are walked during a reorg, `filterInteropTxs` removes interop txs from the reinject set so they aren't re-added to the pool.
- Gated on `len(pool.ingressFilters) > 0`.

## Design Decision
We intentionally **drop** interop transactions when there is a reorg instead of attempting to keep them around. I think this is safe because interop transactions are **not initiated by end users** and therefore can be trivially inserted by the relayer or sequencer. Making this simplification is preferable to adding additional complexity to the already complex mempool.
